one_liner: Shopify upsells driven by what's actually in the cart — no popups, no theme edits, +9.4% AOV on average.
description: cartnudge adds in-cart and post-purchase upsell offers to Shopify stores based on basket contents and store history, rendered natively inside the cart instead of as interruptive popups. Install is one click with no theme code changes, offers are generated automatically from order data, and a flat monthly price replaces the revenue-share pricing common in the category.
target_user: Shopify merchants doing 100+ orders a month

icp.who: Owners and marketers of Shopify stores between $10k and $500k monthly revenue
icp.pain: Upsell apps either spam customers with popups that hurt conversion or demand a percentage of upsell revenue that scales painfully
icp.buying_trigger: AOV flatlining while ad costs rise, making on-site revenue expansion the obvious next lever

differentiators: Offers render natively in the cart — no popups, no conversion-killing interruptions
Basket-aware offer selection generated from the store's own order history
Flat $19/month — no revenue share, no per-order fees
proof_points: 5.0-star rating from the first 22 Shopify App Store reviews
One-click install with zero theme edits, confirmed in reviews

voice.sample_phrase: Bigger carts without a single popup.

signals: Live on the Shopify App Store

gaps: No A/B testing of offers yet

confidence.notes: App Store presence and reviews are public. AOV lift is from the vendor's pilot cohort.
